title: Cap. IV Arg. 9: decree whose foundation is Christ is election itself — salvandis credentibus
pass_a_gloss: Argument 9. That decree of God concerning human salvation whose foundation is Christ is the very election itself to salvation: The decree of God concerning those to be saved who believe is that decree of salvation whose foundation is Christ: Therefore the decree concerning the faithful to be saved is the very election itself to salvation. They say the Major is manifest; because there is no salvation or blessing unto salvation except in Christ. They assert the Minor equally clear; seeing that that only decree is the foundation of Christianity, of salvation, and of certainty concerning salvation: of Christianity; because by it Christ is constituted by God Savior and Head of those who will be partakers of salvation: of Salvation; because this is the decree of good pleasure of God in Christ, on which our whole salvation rests: of Certainty concerning salvation; seeing that all our certainty rests on this prop; Believers will be saved: I believe: Therefore I will be saved.
pass_b_english: Arg. 9. God's decree on human salvation whose foundation is Christ is election itself to salvation. The decree to save believers is that salvation-decree founded on Christ. Therefore the decree to save the faithful is election itself. They call the Major plain — no salvation or blessing unto salvation except in Christ. The Minor equally clear: that one decree is the foundation of Christianity, of salvation, and of certainty of salvation — Christianity, because by it God constitutes Christ Savior and Head of those who will share salvation; salvation, because it is God's good-pleasure decree in Christ on which our whole salvation rests; certainty, because all our assurance rests on this prop: Believers will be saved; I believe; therefore I will be saved.
source_text: Arg. 9. Illud Dei de salute humana decretum cujus fundamentum est Christus, est ipsissima electio ad salutem: Decretum Dei de salvandis credentibus est illud decretum salutis cujus fundamentum est Christus: Ergo decretum de salvandis fidelibus est ipsissima electio ad salutem. Majorem dicunt esse manifestam; quia nulla est salus vel benedictio ad salutem nisi in Christo. Minorem aeque perspicuam asserunt; quandoquidem illud unicum decretum est fundamentum Christianismi, salutis, et certitudinis de salute: Christianismi; quia eo constituitur Christus a Deo Salvator et Caput eorum qui participes salutis futuri sunt: Salutis; quia hoc est decretum εὐδοκίας sive beneplaciti Dei in Christo, cui tota salus nostra innititur: Certitudinis de salute; quandoquidem certitudo nostra omnis huic fulcro innixa est; Credentes salvabuntur: Ego credo: Ergo Ego salvabor.
